empty.name: Vacuum / Air
empty.description: Empty space inside the laboratory tank.

h2o.name: Water
h2o.description: Universal solvent with high surface tension and heat capacity.

h2o_steam.name: Water Vapor (Steam)
h2o_steam.description: Gaseous water phase expanding rapidly upwards.

sio2.name: Silica (Sand)
sio2.description: Silicon dioxide granular mineral forming natural sedimentary banks.

nahco3.name: Sodium Bicarbonate (Baking Soda)
nahco3.description: White crystalline salt used extensively in household baking and acid neutralization.

ch3cooh.name: Acetic Acid (Vinegar)
ch3cooh.hazard_description: Pungent carboxylic acid, mild irritant in household concentrations.
ch3cooh.description: Organic acid providing the distinct sharp aroma and taste in vinegar.

fe.name: Iron Filings
fe.description: Dense, highly conductive transition metal filings susceptible to oxidation.

o2.name: Oxygen
o2.description: Diatomic gaseous oxidizer required for burning and corrosion.

naclo.name: Sodium Hypochlorite (Bleach)
naclo.hazard_description: Strong oxidizing disinfectant. Toxic if combined with ammonia or acids.
naclo.description: Common household bleaching agent and surface disinfectant.

nh3.name: Ammonia (Window Cleaner)
nh3.hazard_description: Corrosive alkaline odor; produces toxic fumes when mixed with hypochlorite.
nh3.description: Volatile alkaline nitrogen hydride prevalent in glass cleaning detergents.

ch3coona.name: Sodium Acetate
ch3coona.description: The mild sodium salt of acetic acid, produced by baking soda and vinegar.

co2.name: Carbon Dioxide
co2.hazard_description: Asphyxiant at extreme concentrations; buoyant extinguishing gas.
co2.description: Heavy carbon gas that causes bubbling effervescence and displaces liquids upward.

fe2o3.name: Iron(III) Oxide (Rust)
fe2o3.description: Reddish-brown brittle oxide formed when metallic iron oxidizes in moisture.

nh2cl.name: Chloramine Gas
nh2cl.hazard_description: DANGER: Lethal toxic gas formed by mixing bleach with ammonia. Causes acute respiratory distress.
nh2cl.description: Unstable toxic gas generated inadvertently by household cleaner misuse.

naoh.name: Sodium Hydroxide (Lye / Caustic Soda)
naoh.hazard_description: Extremely caustic alkali. Causes severe skin burns and blindness.
naoh.description: Corrosive alkaline base used in industrial manufacturing and chemical drain unclogging.

na.name: Sodium Metal
na.hazard_description: Violently water-reactive alkali metal. Ignites spontaneously on contact with water.
na.description: Soft alkali metal that reacts explosively with water to liberate hydrogen and heat.

h2.name: Hydrogen Gas
h2.hazard_description: Extremely buoyant and explosive fuel gas.
h2.description: Lightest element in the universe, rising rapidly through air tanks.

hcl.name: Hydrochloric Acid (Muriatic Acid)
hcl.hazard_description: Strong mineral acid; corrosive vapor that attacks metals and biological tissue.
hcl.description: Fuming aqueous solution of hydrogen chloride used for masonry cleaning and pH regulation.

nacl.name: Sodium Chloride (Table Salt)
nacl.description: Common ionic mineral crystal formed by the neutralization of sodium and chlorine.

c.name: Carbon (Charcoal)
c.description: Pure elemental carbon fuel that undergoes exothermic combustion in oxygen.

ch4.name: Methane (Natural Gas)
ch4.description: Simplest alkane gas providing intense combustion energy.

c2h5oh.name: Ethanol (Alcohol)
c2h5oh.description: Clear organic solvent with low density that floats on water.

h2o2.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
h2o2.description: Unstable peroxide that decomposes into water and oxygen gas upon activation.

cao.name: Calcium Oxide (Quicklime)
cao.hazard_description: Corrosive caustic mineral; releases extreme heat when hydrated.
cao.description: Alkaline mineral that slakes violently in water to release substantial heat.

ca_oh_2.name: Calcium Hydroxide (Slaked Lime)
ca_oh_2.description: Hydrated lime compound used in mortar, plaster, and carbon dioxide detection.

caco3.name: Calcium Carbonate (Chalk / Limestone)
caco3.description: Primary constituent of chalk, eggshells, limestone, and sea shells.

cu.name: Copper Filings
cu.description: Reddish metallic particulate with outstanding electrical and thermal conductivity.

cl2.name: Chlorine Gas
cl2.hazard_description: HIGHLY TOXIC yellow-green choking gas. Severe respiratory hazard.
cl2.description: Dense halogen gas released when bleach is mixed with concentrated acids.
